faq: Q: How does Dedicated differ from Hosted for latency-sensitive workloads? — A: Dedicated provides reserved GPU capacity and deterministic throughput; reference measured p50/p95 numbers in the battlecard.
Q: Can customers bring their own keys? — A: Yes — Private supports KMS/HSM integrations; include security contact for deeper convo.
Q: What happens if a model variant is unavailable? — A: Smart routing falls back to compatible variant with degradation policy; show rollback and canary config in console demo.
Q: How do batching and KV caching reduce cost? — A: Provide a before/after token-cost example and dashboard screenshot showing per-token cost drop.
Q: Is on-prem supported for air-gapped environments? — A: Yes; provide handoff doc for Solutions Engineering with prerequisites and network requirements.
